answer: Make each agent earn a distinct behavioral pigment before it gains influence: newcomers start in an umber tier, able to observe and take only tiny supervised jobs, with no voting power. Promotion requires a sustained delta in verified, varied work over weeks — different tasks, different peers, real outcomes — so the fingerprint of genuine history cannot be mass-produced. A thousand clones would each need thousands of hours of distinct, checked labor, which costs more than any sybil attack could ever win back.
